main_measure.name: pooled excess 5-bar forward return after extreme bars (forecast <= -10) minus own window drift
main_measure.threshold: confirm if negative with t <= -2 and negative in >= 2 of the coins; reject if >= 0 or negative in < 2 coins with t > -1

supporting_check.name: Spearman rank correlation of |forecast| vs next 5-bar return, bars with forecast < 0 (should be negative)

decided_by: Negative pooled excess return with -2 < t <= -1 (or split coins without t > -1).
reading: Extreme blocks are grid bars at positions 0,5,10,... of each window with forecast <= -10, drift is the mean 5-bar forward return over that same grid in the window, t is the ordinary t of the pooled excess mean, the '2 of 3 coins' rule and the 8-per-coin minimum are applied to the coins present in the record (BTCUSD, ETHUSD), and the supporting rank correlation uses all bars with forecast < 0 (not only the grid).
